sentences.en: When you want cooperation, share the work among many hands.
sentences.zh: 当你想要合作时，要把工作分给多人来做。

sentences.en: We won hands down, because the other players were weak.
sentences.zh: 我们轻松获胜，因为其他选手实力较弱。

sentences.en: The store changed hands at the end of last summer.
sentences.zh: 这家店在去年夏天末易主了。
